Hi, I'm interleaves (GitHub: psinary-sketch), new contributor and new to ZULIP. i appreciate you'alls' orientation or assist.

I have two PRs open that need CI approval (first-time contributor workflow):
PR #36324 — feat(NumberTheory/LSeries): Schwarz reflection for completedRiemannZeta₀ Three theorems:

  • completedRiemannZeta₀_conj (Schwarz reflection: Λ₀(conj s) = conj(Λ₀(s)))
  • completedRiemannZeta₀_im_eq_zero_on_half (real-valued on critical line)
  • completedRiemannZeta₀_conj_eq_self_on_half (fixed-point formulation)

The proof uses the fact that the Mellin kernel is real-valued, so the integral commutes with conjugation. ~147 lines, standalone file Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/SchwarzReflectionZeta.lean.
PR #36625 — feat(Analysis/Complex): analytic order characterization of simple zeros One theorem:

  • analyticOrderAt_eq_one_iff_deriv_ne_zero (vanishing order 1 ↔ nonzero derivative)

Connects the analyticOrderAt API to concrete derivative information. ~65 lines, file Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/MeromorphicLogDeriv.lean.

Both compile locally against current master. Would appreciate a maintainer approving CI runs. Learning as i go, but can attempt to address any review feedback.
May you please disclose any AI usage?
btw, the PR already appears on the review board as it passed the main CI. I was once told that those CI that needs approval are not "important". Still better to have some one approve it, I guess
Was referring to #36324. The other one has failed CI
Indeed, the CI that actually needs to pass (the jobs starting with "continuous integration (mathlib forks)") runs without need for approval. In any case, I've approved the other CI jobs.
Thanks Weiyi and Bryan! Good to know about the CI distinction. I see #36625 has a some sort of failure — attempted to push a fix.
